gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have Grade 4 isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild type GBM with local pathology confirmed MGMT-promoter unmethylated status.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: used as adjuvant treatment in patients with newly diagnosed GBM who are MGMT unmethylated and have completed concomitant treatment with temozolomide and radiation

role_evidence.quote: Phase 1 study of single agent tinostamustine, used as adjuvant treatment

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating and histone deacetylase inhibiting molecule (bendamustine-vorinostat hybrid)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Novel Alkylating and Deacetylase Inhibiting Molecule

source_quote.quote: Patients must have Grade 4 isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild type GBM with local pathology confirmed MGMT-promoter unmethylated status.
Confirmed IDH wild type. The presence of an IDH mutation will be exclusionary for study enrolment.

coder_notes: Registered phase is EARLY_PHASE1 (text says Phase 1). Temozolomide plus radiotherapy was completed before entry and is not a registered intervention or given on study, so it is not listed as an agent. Only plasma PK is planned.
